summary: First test iteration for HomeFlow. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases passed against the public URL, covering auth (register, login, /me, invalid/missing token 401), founder detection (is_founder & is_premium both True for susanrodriguesp@gmail.com), all CRUD (wallets, transactions with balance mutation & rollback on delete, goals, tasks, shopping, events, cards), dashboard/summary aggregates, /founders list contains both seeded emails, /ai/chat returns real GPT-4o-mini reply via emergentintegrations. Frontend: verified Welcome screen with both CTAs, register flow -> /(tabs)/home (balance R$ 0,00), tab navigation Início/Finanças/Tarefas/Mercado works, 3 chip segments render on single row (does NOT wrap), wallet modal creates wallet, transaction modal decrements balance correctly (500 - 30 = R$ 470,00), Profile page shows 'Premium Founder' badge for founder email with theme toggle (Claro/Escuro/Sistema) and Sair da Conta button, AI-chat screen renders with welcome message and suggestion chips. No critical bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking but should migrate. Likely emitted by expo-blur / LinearGradient / third-party components used in home.tsx and financas.tsx.

action_items: (Optional) Silence RN web deprecation warnings by migrating style.shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents where used in custom components. These are warnings only.
AI-chat testIDs in playbook doc: input is 'chat-input' and send is 'chat-send' (documented here so next iteration uses correct selectors).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_wallet / create_tx etc. insert doc.copy() into Mongo but Motor mutates the doc with _id; the code then does doc.pop('_id', None) on the original which is unnecessary because .copy() already isolated it. Harmless.
server.py delete_transaction: sign for rollback correctly inverts type but there is no HTTP error if tid does not exist (silently returns ok). Minor.
financas.tsx TxModal: does not filter by non-empty wallets and could submit with invalid walletId if wallets is empty (add-tx-btn already guards by opening wallet modal). OK.
home.tsx & financas.tsx: files are still under 700 lines and DRY is acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (welcome, register, login, home, financas chips, wallet create, transaction with balance update, profile founder badge, tab navigation, ai chat screen render)
